about:
Wire Winders Inc. was established in 1991 in Milford, New Hampshire, by a group of coil winding experts who collectively brought more than 60 years of industry experience. The company operates from a facility on Mont Vernon Road in Milford and has remained focused on custom magnetic components since its inception.

The firm specializes in custom wound magnetic devices and assemblies of varying type and size, offering services from prototype through full production runs. Its core capability is custom coil winding, taking customer ideas, drawings, or specifications from concept to finished product with advanced technical and manufacturing expertise.

Wire Winders serves a broad range of sectors, including aerospace, scientific research, medical, audio, printing, military, academic, semiconductor, communications, transportation, and general manufacturing.

The company’s guiding principle, “Where the Unusual is Commonplace,” reflects its focus on solving non‑standard winding challenges. It emphasizes design optimization, customized service matching individual specifications, and a commitment to responsive attention and uncompromising quality.
